title: Replace removed VSTest session orchestration
goal: Discover and run tests from a custom VSTest host after pooled test-session APIs disappear; preserve result counts, cancellation and cleanup using the documented console protocol connection.

selectionNotes: Package acquisition is separate from SDK/runtime releases and artifact identity.
Current packages actually compile/run on .NET10; this conditional route adds no foundation.

packageAssets: TranslationLayer/TestHost/ObjectModel18.7/18.11 compile/runtime assets are measured during restore; CLI18.7/18.11 supplies a complete net10.0 contentFiles console, Build is lib/netstandard2.0.
SDK10 PlatformAbstractions product18.7.0-release-26505-111 is different from public18.7.0: only the audited SDK copy has mutable RequestingAssembly. Public18.9 already has the constructor.
Public source commits: 6f58ced50b40e074a07ffc21fb2d2eef95d31b60 (18.7), 36206450d47fec22e281ba9846445edc796f5080 (18.11). SDK11's 18.11.0-release-26504-105 is separate, not byte-equal.
platforms: Windows x64 real local execution; other OS/architectures, Framework/older targets unqualified.
prerequisites: PowerShell7; exact sample SDK10.0.402/runtime10.0.13 and SDK11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105/runtime11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105; public NuGet restore; no workload, native compiler, credentials, service or device.
Isolate samples from root central packages; retain generated locks and use locked restore. Use absolute dotnet executables and DOTNET_ADD_GLOBAL_TOOLS_TO_PATH=0 for isolated CLI homes.
constraints: Original adapter executes arithmetic assertions, deliberate failure, settings and readiness-signaled cancellation through real VSTest; it is a teaching adapter, not a platform mock.
StartSession/EndSession own the documented console connection, distinct from removed StartTestSession/StopTestSession/ITestSession and pooled testhost lifetime.
Legacy resolver pins the audited SDK10 DLL; current resolver uses the actual public package. No nonexistent public18.7 RequestingAssembly route or independent stable SDK-embedding promise.
The real AppDomain bridge preserves its requesting plugin. Actual .NET PlatformAssemblyResolver uses ALC.Resolving and supplies null; Framework behavior is not inferred.
Current scalar CLI settings split on semicolons/newlines after MSBuild unescaping. For literal semicolons use VSTestSetting and an XML file, a different input contract.
No MTP drop-in, pooled lifetime/performance equivalence, arbitrary adapter/collector compatibility, JSON migration, general plugin security, Unix backslash, remote, trimming or NativeAOT claim.
stabilityLimitations: Public18.11 packages are stable; .NET11 SDK/runtime proof is RC2. No experimental opt-in is required for the current route; removed old pooling was unfinished/obsolete.
PIN-959 coverage/evidence, PIN-963 actual-GA reconciliation and Human gates remain open; preserve the exact eight .NET10 foundations.
